evidence: CDIAL 13519 lists the suvarṇa/sauvarṇa gold continuations jointly because the branches are often indistinguishable, including Phal. suāṇ, H. sonā, B. sonā, Or. sunā, WPah. sunnō, jaun. sūnō and G. sɔnũ. These reviewed simple gold responses preserve the corresponding s/ś, rounded-vowel, nasal and geminate variants. Following the user’s explicit sauvarṇa choice, link them to 13519.2; this is an editorial resolution of the ambiguous branch, with possible intra-Indo-Aryan transmission left open.
